text.tspan: line greeting detected, waiting before speaking
“Thanks for calling. How can I help today?”
“Hi, I’d like to book a check-up next Tuesday.”
“I can do 9:15 on Tuesday. Want me to confirm?”
“Let me transfer you to the pharmacy now.”

svg.text: When the agent can’t resolve a request in-line, it says
it is transferring the caller and then hangs up. The
patient’s original request is never resolved.
Found by the cross-call pass. Judged one call at a
time, it showed up as six unrelated minor issues.
